brief:
US officials visited Taybeh, a Christian Palestinian village in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, on Sunday, according to Al-Monitor. The visit followed attacks by militant Israeli settlers on European diplomats and other international envoys in the region.

Tensions between Israeli settlers and the international community have intensified over settlement expansion and Palestinian rights in occupied territory. The specific details of the settler attacks and the purpose of the US diplomatic mission were not disclosed in the initial report.
